claims.statement: Management maintains 20% CAGR guidance for base business for next couple of years
Gross margin guidance maintained at 40% plus/minus 2%
Dhanuka Laboratories revenue expected to grow 15% in FY25 with EBITDA growing in same proportion
Dhanuka Laboratories EBITDA margin expected to remain in 6-8% range
Enmetazobactam India sales expected to reach INR 75-100 crores in 3 years post launch
7ACA project capex deployment 25-33% in FY25
Cefiderocol project capex $15 million, investment to start next quarter
Oral capacity expansion budgeted at INR 25-30 crores for FY25
Sterile facility operating at 80% capacity utilization in Q4 FY24
7ACA facility targeting 2/3 (66%) utilization in first year post commissioning
Small capacity oral expansion expected to commission in Q2 FY25
Enmetazobactam received US FDA and EMA approvals; India Phase III waiver granted
Enmetazobactam India launch advanced to next quarter (Q2 FY25) from mid-2025
ANDA filed for Cefepime/Enmetazobactam in USA
Cefiderocol project in collaboration with GARDP/Shionogi, commissioning expected in 2026
Ceftaroline to launch in India via AMS division as first generic
Cefovecin process ready, partnering for US FDF development
Zavicefta (Ceftazidime Avibactam) Para-IV filed in Orchid's name
Employee expenses decreased from 9.8% to 8.5% of sales; other expenses from 19.9% to 18.9%
Gross margins stable with slight slip from 42% to 41%
Full-year revenue growth expected to moderate to 20-25% despite strong Q1
AMS division targets Rs 100 crore sales in 3-4 years
Enmetazobactam global sales potential estimated at $200-300 million annually over patent life
Cefiderocol commercial sales expected before March 2027
Cefiderocol CAPEX one-third in FY25, maximum in FY26
New sterile block at 50% utilization, oral capacity at 90% utilization
7ACA project land acquired, groundbreaking on Ganesh Chaturthi, commissioning by April 2026, full utilization FY28
Q1 FY25 EBITDA Rs 41 crore, up 71% YoY; employee expenses 8.7% of sales, other expenses 16% of sales
AMS division currently EBITDA drag of Rs 1.5 crore, team of 40-50 people in place
Cefiderocol deal structured as cost plus 25% at PBT level
Europe Enmetazobactam first sales expected in Q2 FY25, numbers by next call
Management expects 5% annual sales growth for Dhanuka business, with EBITDA margins remaining in single digits.
H1 FY25 EBITDA was INR78.6 crores, up from INR54.7 crores in H1 FY24; operating EBITDA grew 39% year-on-year.
Enmetazobactam sales have started in EU market; initial numbers are insignificant as sales began recently.
7ACA project capex estimated at INR700 crores total; INR35 crores spent so far; commissioning target April 2026.
Small capacity enhancement project commissioned ahead of schedule; validation batches completed; will contribute to sales in coming months.
New oral block fully ready for production; ramp-up depends on sales generation and customer vendor approval process.
Gross margin guidance stable at 40% plus/minus 2% for near term; EBITDA margin expansion of ~100 bps per year expected
Gross margins maintained despite price corrections due to cost reductions; EBITDA drag of INR6 cr from AMS division in 9M FY25
Enmetazobactam domestic sales via Cipla partnership progressing as per plan; royalty income received in Q2 and Q3 FY25, Q3 significantly larger
7ACA project budget INR600 cr, INR80 cr spent so far; water trials targeted April 2026; major equipment ordering to complete by Q1 FY26
No capacity expansion planned in sterile business for next 2 years; oral capacity sufficient for growth track
FY26 expected to be muted due to pricing pressure and 7-ACA capex ramp-up; mid-teen EBITDA margin aspiration remains intact
7-ACA project mechanical completion delayed to December 2026; first commercial product targeted for March 2027
Capex spent on 7-ACA project is Rs. 120 crores, not Rs. 40 crores as previously understood
Cefiderocol validation batches expected last quarter of 2026; commercial launch expected Q2 calendar 2027 (September 2027)
Enmetazobactam (Orblicef) performed better than estimates with 10,000 patients treated in half year vs full year estimate of 10,000
Base business margins have bottomed out; no further margin decline expected as pressure is on all competitors
Plan to file 2-3 differentiated cephalosporin ANDAs for US market in next 12-18 months
Management expects muted FY26 with no near-term revival in antibiotics market
Gross margins maintained around 42% despite 29% sales decline
Orblicef domestic brand performing steadily with consistent demand patterns
7ACA project in Jammu on track for Q1 FY27 commissioning; Cefiderocol project on track for December 2026
Ceftaroline and Cefovecin API DMF filing certain; FDF timeline not confirmed
No FY26 guidance for Dhanuka Labs due to uncertain market conditions
Global margins 32% in Q2 vs 43% in Q1 due to inventory revaluation and higher emerging market sales at lower prices
EBITDA INR6 crore in Q2 vs INR14 crore in Q1 due to margin compression and inventory revaluation
No signs of demand revival in current financial year; priorities are licensing Exblifep, project execution, business development, frugal management, and hospital sales growth
7ACA project: all fermenters erected, major equipment arriving, targeting mechanical completion as previously announced despite rain delays
Cefiderocol project building structure nearly complete, equipment deliveries begun, targeting production readiness by Q4 FY26
Europe Exblifep price approvals in top 5 EU markets expected by end of calendar year; sales data from next quarter; US licensing target within 12 months
Exblifep economic benefits effective from Aug 1; meaningful royalty flows expected from next financial year as price approvals complete
Mechanical completion of 7ACA project targeted by September 2025; commercial production expected 1-2 quarters after
U.S. licensing deal for Exblifep targeted within FY26
Teflaro and Avycaz U.S. filings expected this year or early next year; partner agreements advanced
Q3 gross margin ~31% due to lower regulated mix (1/4 vs 1/3) and inventory devaluation; regulated margins 40-65%
Non-regulated margins depressed but improving slightly in January; raw material prices also improving
Exblifep: binding term sheet signed in one key geography, non-binding in one major regulated market; advanced talks with 3-4 large markets
Exblifep Europe sales commenced in Spain and Italy; volumes up >200% QoQ on small base
Capacity utilization down to ~60% from 80% two years ago; can generate >INR1,200 cr turnover without new capex
Capital work in progress Rs 340.52 crore
Intangible assets under development Rs 73.08 crore
Cefiderocol access project capex Rs 200 Cr committed
Plan to launch 5-6 sterile products in US by 2030
Targeting 10-15% sales growth for FY27 base business
Targeting ~12% EBITDA margin for base business in FY27
Merger expected to contribute 1-2% EBITDA margin expansion
Fill-finish capex estimated at INR50 crores as part of Cefiderocol facility
7ACA project on track for Q1 CY2027 commissioning
Cefiderocol facility on track for end of CY2026 commissioning, launch Q2/Q3 CY2027
Exblifep commercialization early stage, selling in India and Europe with 4x QoQ growth
Exblifep commercial discussions active in US, Russia, Latin America, Southeast Asia with term-sheets and definitive agreements under discussion
Exblifep lifetime sales maintained at $1-2 billion, peak in year 4-5 post-launch
Q4 FY26 gross margins recovered from Q2/Q3 lows of 31-32% as lower-priced inventory replaced high-cost stock
AMS platform remains ~INR8 crore annual EBITDA drag but strategically important for Cefiderocol market entry
Management declined to provide FY27 revenue growth guidance
Q1 FY27 gross margin improved ~3pp to 33% vs Q1 FY26; EBITDA rose to INR25 cr from INR10 cr
Cefixime under maximum margin pressure in rest-of-world markets; other 7-ACA-based APIs more stable
Exblifep Europe volumes grew 300% QoQ in Q3 FY26, 170% in Q4 FY26, 50% in Q1 FY27
Russia Exblifep licensing estimated 10-year value ~USD178 million; registration and launch in 1.5-2 years
FY27 capex focused on completing 7-ACA (INR750 cr) and cefiderocol (USD20-25 mn) projects; no significant new capex
7-ACA Jammu plant targets commissioning and first commercial batch by March 2027; ramp-up to 80-100% utilization in first year
Cefiderocol facility commissioning by Dec 2026, validation and initial batches Jan-Mar 2027; commercial launch subject to DCGI approval
Non-current assets up Rs 368 Cr led by capital work-in-progress on 7ACA and Cefiderocol projects
EXBLIFEP licensing partnerships signed with Pharmasyntez (Russia, US$178M potential) and Laboratorio Libra (Latin America 9 markets, US$80M potential)
Management does not give short-term profit margin guidance as organizational policy
Endeavor to keep gross margin above 35% through product mix management
Gross margin improved ~8pp YoY to ~39% in Q2 FY27 due to inventory normalization, better volumes and mix
EBITDA margin improved to 15% in Q2 FY27 from 7% YoY despite higher fuel costs and one-time provisions
EXBLIFEP royalties and licensing fees improving each quarter; current run rate $3-4 million per year
Russia EXBLIFEP deal: estimated 10-year sales ~$178 million; Latin America deal: ~$80 million
Hopeful of signing 3-4 additional EXBLIFEP license agreements over next two quarters (Australia, SE Asia, Japan, other LatAm, North Africa)
7-ACA project (Jammu): 1,000 MTPA capacity; significant investment completed; commercial ops scheduled March 2027
Dhanuka facility at 80-90% utilization; Orchid at 60%; debottlenecking done; rationalizing duplicate capacities
